snippet.title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World Director's Cut - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the latest trailer for Nikoderiko The Magical World Directors Cut, now with a new world and boss, voiceover updates, new music, and a brand new hard mode. Nikoderiko: The Magical World Director's Cut is available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, and PC. 
Presented by Nikoderiko: The Magical World Director's Cut
